questions.prompt: A traffic-lane control light with an illuminated red "X" means:
questions.explanation: A red X over a lane means you must not drive in that lane. A green arrow pointing down means the lane is open.

choices.text: Prepare for an emergency vehicle travelling in that lane
Reduce speed to below 30 km/h
Use that lane only for the purpose of making a left turn
Travel is not permitted in that lane

questions.prompt: A driver approaching a flashing red traffic light must:
questions.explanation: Treat a flashing red light like a stop sign: come to a complete stop, then go only when it is safe. Key words: "flashing red traffic light".

choices.text: Stop and wait for the flashing green light
Reduce speed and proceed with caution
Stop and proceed only when safe to do so
Stop until the signal light turns green

questions.prompt: What does a flashing yellow traffic light mean?
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light warns of a hazard or a busy intersection. Slow down and proceed with caution. Key words: "flashing yellow".

choices.text: Proceed with caution
The traffic light will turn green
Stop until the light stops flashing
The traffic light will turn red

questions.prompt: Is a driver allowed to turn right at a red traffic control light?
questions.explanation: You may turn right on a red light after coming to a complete stop, unless a sign prohibits it. Yield to pedestrians and traffic first. Key words: "stops", "no traffic, pedestrian or sign".

choices.text: Yes, but only when a sign permits such a turn
Yes, if the driver reduces speed and there is no traffic or pedestrian in the intersection, and no sign that prohibits such a turn
Yes, if the driver stops and there is no traffic, pedestrian or sign that prohibits such a turn
No, right turns on a red traffic light are never permitted

questions.prompt: When approaching an intersection displaying a steady yellow traffic light:
questions.explanation: A steady yellow light means the light is about to turn red. Stop before the intersection unless you are so close that you cannot stop safely.

choices.text: Proceed since the light is about to turn green
Yield to vehicles on the right
Stop before the intersection unless the stop cannot be made in safety
Increase speed to clear the intersection

questions.prompt: A solid yellow line together with a broken yellow line marked on the centre of a highway means:
questions.explanation: When a solid and a broken yellow line run side by side, the line closest to you applies. If the broken line is on your side, you may pass when it is safe; if the solid line is on your side, you may not.

choices.text: The road narrows ahead
If the solid line is on your side, passing is permitted
If the broken line is on your side, passing is not permitted
If the broken line is on your side, passing is permitted
